test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

The lady said, “Most of the trains are running late today.”

options.text: The lady said that most of the trains were running late the next day.
The lady said that most of the trains were running late that day.
The lady said that most of the trains are running late that day.
The lady said that most of the trains were running late today.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The lady said that most of the trains were running late that day."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the structure of reported speech, the reporting clause ('the lady said') is followed by 'that' (sometimes omitted in informal speech) and then the reported clause, which usually involves a shift in tense, pronouns, and time and place references. Here, the present simple 'are running late' becomes the past simple 'were running late', and the present time reference 'today' becomes 'that day'.
 
• "The lady said that most of the trains were running late that day." - Correct. It accurately reflects the tense shift**(are-->were)** and change in time marker**(today-->that day)** typical of reported speech.
 
 
• **Direct Speech:** "Most of the trains are running late today," said the lady.
 
• **Indirect Speech: **The lady said that most of the trains were running late that day.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Let's evaluate the given options one by one based on how well they illustrate the rules of reported speech:**

 
 
• "The lady said that most of the trains were running late the next day." - Incorrect as the time reference "the next day" is not accurate. She was referring to the current day.
 
• "The lady said that most of the trains are running late that day." - Incorrect. The tense has not been shifted to past tense.
 
• "The lady said that most of the trains were running late today." - Incorrect. "Today" should become "that day" in reported speech.
